description: The oath of glory binds a paladin to personal excellence and heroic deeds.

features.name: Warrior of Glory
features.description: STR and DEX checks have advantage for 1 minute after melee hit.

features.name: Aura of Glory
features.description: Allies within aura gain proficiency with weapons.

features.name: Peerless Athlete
features.description: Advantage on athletic checks when within your oath's aura.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.description: Reaction to gain AC boost when ally is attacked near you.
